content: Mariyani kememɨte'utami
Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:
«Mexi pekamɨwe, 'apaapama wahetsɨa pekaheyeiwe, mariyanitsixi pekaniwatakwimɨkɨ pekatiniwakuhɨwieriemɨkɨ 'ateɨterima wahetsiemieme».
Muitsexi 'ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Xekeneuyukuha'aritɨa hipatɨ temuhukɨ mariyanitsixi temuwatakwinikɨ. Mɨkɨ wahetsie Yawé katinayukatuamɨkɨ.
Yuxexuitɨ 'Ixaheri nuiwarimama xeimiriyari yuteɨterima mekewarenɨ'axɨani».
'Ixaheri nuiwarimama yuxexuitɨ mekaniwarenɨ'axɨani xeimiriyari yuteɨterima, yunaitɨ mekanakɨne tamamata heimana huta miriyari (12.000) 'ukitsi memuyukwiyukɨ.

Muitsexi kaniwarenɨ'ani tamamata heimana huta miriyari 'ukitsi. Wahamatɨa kaneyani Pinexi mawari wewiwame nu'aya 'Eriyatsaxi, mɨhɨritɨariekai piinite tukita timieme metatsiere kuxineta mutahɨtsiwanikɨ kepauka memuyutakwini hetsiemieme.
Yawé Muitsexi kemɨtiuta'aitɨakai, 'ixaheritsixi mekaniuyutakwini, mekaniwarukwini yunaime 'ukitsi mariyanitsixi.
'Ewi, Xekeni, Tsuxi, Kuxi meta Xewa mariyani kwieyaritsie yu'aɨxɨwitɨ memɨte'aitamete 'ixiparakɨ mekaniukwi'iwa, metatsiere Warami Wehuxi nu'aya mekaniumieni.
'Ukarawetsixi mekaniwarutiwiya meta tɨɨri mariyanitsixi waniwema, wa'iwarika mayanikɨ wawakaitsixi mekaniwarehapani, wamuxatsi meta wapiinite.
Mariyanitsixi wakiekari meta memukutetɨkateitsie naime mekateniutitaiya,
yunaime teɨteri mekaniwarehapani meta tewaxi. Naime tita memɨte'u'axixɨ meta tita mɨtiwapiinitɨkai

Muitsexi meta mawari wewiwame 'Eriyatsaxi mekateniyetuirieni meta yunaime 'ixaheritsixi. Yunaime memɨwarehapa meta tita memɨte'u'axixɨ mekatenepini memakuteitsie Muhawi makuweritsie, haa manuyehane Kurutani 'aurie, metatsiere Keriku hɨxie.
Muitsexi, mawari wewiwame 'Eriyatsaxi hamatɨa meta yunaitɨ 'ixaheri kiekariyaritsie memanuyetei mekanayekɨne mewareunakiyuka 'ateewa mematiteitsie.
Muitsexi waɨkawa kaniha'akaitɨni xeimiriyari wa'ukiyari wahetsɨa xeitsienituyari xeikɨa memanuaxɨakɨ.
Mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'iwawiya: «¿Titayarikuta 'ukarawetsixi xekatewarekwi?
Mɨkɨ 'ukarawetsixi Warami kemɨtiwakuxaxatɨwakai 'axawayurietɨ, 'ayumieme 'ixaheritsixi Yawé mepuku'eirie Wahari-Pehuxi pɨta memayexeiyanikɨ. 'Ayumieme Yawé teɨterimama mekaniukwini kwiniyakɨ.
Yunaime tɨɨri xekeniwarukuya meta yunaime 'ukarawetsixi memɨmayɨiyatɨka,
kaniyɨweni hɨrixɨa 'ukari memɨkamayɨiyatɨka xemɨwarewitɨni.
Ke'aixɨa memɨteyu'itiekai teyukwikate meta memanutaxɨriwa

»Yunaitɨ kemɨ'ane hipame memɨwarekwi, yatɨni kemɨ'ane mɨkite memɨwaremayɨa, 'ateewa meniyuhayewakuni xematiteitsie 'atahuta tukari. Hairieka tukari 'anukamiekaku meta 'atahuta tukari 'anukamiekaku, xekaniyu'itiekuni meta kemɨ'ane xemɨwaretiwi.
Metatsiere yukemarite mekaniti'ekwakuni, meta nawikɨ mɨtiwewiyatɨka, tsipuri wahuxari 'ɨkariyari, yatɨni kɨyekɨ mɨtiwewiyatɨka».
'Eriyatsaxi mawari wewiwame mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe kuyaxi kemɨ'ane memeyukukwikai: «Mɨpaɨ kanaineni 'inɨari niukiyari Yawé Muitsexi miyetuiri:
Huru tepɨayari, pɨrata, purunitse, tepɨa, 'Etsitaniyu, purumu,
naitɨ tita tai mɨtinewiwe, taipa katineuxɨriyamɨkɨ mɨti'itiyanikɨ, perutsiere haa mɨtiyu'itiwakɨ kanitihauxinariemɨkɨ. Tita tai mɨkatinewie mɨkɨ hakɨkɨ xeikɨa 'aixɨa kaniti'itɨariemɨkɨ.
'Atahutarieka tukaritsie, 'ana xeme yukamixate xekateniti'ekwakuni 'ana xe'itiyatɨ xekaniyuhayewakuni. 'Anake yunaitɨ mematitei xekani'axɨakuni».
Tita memɨteha'iwaxɨ kememɨteyutapitɨani
Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:
«'Ekɨ meta mawari wewime 'Eriyatsaxi meta 'ukirawetsixi 'ixaheritsixi xekaniwati'inɨatakuni teɨteri memutiwiyarie meta tewaxi.
Xekateniwatapitɨakuni kuyaxi memɨteha'iwaxɨ kemɨ'ane memeyukukwi meta yunaitɨ kiekatari yaxeikɨa tipapaɨmeme.

Kemɨ'ane memeyukukwi mɨpaɨ pekatiniwatahɨawimɨkɨ memɨte'a'iwaxɨ hetsie Yawé hetsiemieme memenaka'ɨnikɨ. Teɨteri yunaime tewaxi puxuri, wakaitsixi, muxatsi, xeime pekananakahanimɨkɨ 'auxɨwime tsienituyaritsie.
Ketipaɨmeme memɨte'uta'axixɨtsie kuyaxi mana pekaniwaranakahapaniriexɨamɨkɨ, mawari wewiwame 'Eriyatsaxi pekatiniyetuiriemɨkɨ 'imikieri mayanikɨ Yawé hetsiemieme.

'Ixaheritsixi ketipaɨmetɨ wahetsie mɨtikunanake, yuxexuime pekatiniwareukuhapaniriemɨkɨ huta tewiyari heimana tamamatatsie, 'ɨimarixi yaxeikɨata wapuxuri, wakaitsixi, muxatsi tsepa tita tewayari, mɨkɨ rewitsixi pekatiniwayetuiriemɨkɨ, mɨkɨ netuki memɨ'ɨwiya memɨhɨkɨkɨ».
Muitsexi meta mawari wewiwame 'Eriyatsaxi yamekateniuyurieni Yawé Muitsexi kemɨtiuta'aitɨa.
Kuyaxi tita memɨtehepikairi kati'inɨaritɨ, tita memɨte'a'iwaxɨ katinihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni 'ataxewime tsienituyari heimana haika tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'auxɨwime miriyari (675.000) muxatsi,
haika tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana huta miriyari (72.000) wakaitsixi,
haika tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana xewi miriyari (71.000) puxuri
metatsiere xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana huta miriyari (32.000) 'ukari 'ukitsi wahamatɨa memɨkakahiwawe.
Kemɨ'ane memeyukukwi mɨpaɨ tipaɨmeme mekatenepini:
Haika tsienituyari heimana xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'atahuta miriyari, heimana 'auxɨwi tsienituyari (337.500) muxatsi,
Yawé hetsiemieme mekaniyetuiyani 'ataxewime tsienituyari heimana haika tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'auxɨwi (675).
Xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'ataxewime miriyari (36.000) wakaitsixi, meta Yawé hetsiemieme mekaniyetuiyani haika tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana huta.
Huta tewiyari heimana tamamata miriyari heimana 'auxɨwime tsienituyari (30.500) puxuri, mekaniyetuiyani Yawé hetsiemieme haika tewiyari heimana xewi.
Tamamata heimana 'ataxewime miriyari (16.000) 'ukari, Yawé hetsiemiemeta mekaniyetuiyani xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana huta.
Yawé hetsie mɨtimiemetɨkai, Muitsexi mawari wewiwame 'Eriyatsaxi katiniyetuirieni Yawé kemɨtiwaruta'aitɨakai.
Kuyaxi memɨteha'iwaxɨ memɨte'atɨa, Muitsexi hixɨata ti'akame 'ixaheritsixi katiniwayetuirieni,
'ayumieme 'ixaheritsixi wahetsiemieme katinayani haika tsienituyari heimana xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'atahuta miriyari heimana 'auxɨwime tsienituyari (337.500) muxatsi,
xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'ataxewi miriyari (36.000) wakaitsixi,
xeitewiyari heimana tamamata miriyari heimana 'auxɨwi tsienituyari (30.500) puxuri
metatsiere tamamata heimana 'ataxewi miriyari (16.000) 'ukari.

'Ixaheritsixi wahetsiemieme mɨratɨa, Muitsexi huta tewiyari heimana tamamata teɨteriyaritsie yuxexuime kaniwareukuhapanirieni meta huta tewiyari heimana tamamatatsie yuxexuime tewaxi, yemekɨ Yawé kemɨtita'aitɨakai, hikɨ mɨkɨ tinaime mepɨteyetuiriyarie rewitsixi, Yawé tukieya memɨhɨritɨariekai.
Kuyaxi tewa'aitɨwamete wamawarika
Hikɨ teɨteri kuyaxi memɨhɨritɨarietɨka, tatsɨari xeimiriyari memɨhɨritɨarietɨka meta xeitsienituyari memɨhɨritɨarietɨka, Muitsexi hepa me'ukɨneka
mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: «'Anɨ'arima yukuyaxima mekaniwaruti'inɨata, nixewitɨ pɨkaheuyewetse keyupaɨmeme temuhɨritɨarie.

'Ayumieme Yawé hetsiemieme mawari tepɨwewie, ketita temɨteyetuaxɨa hurute taxexuitɨ: mamatsiemieme, tepɨa kukari huru matsɨwayari, kuka menawutɨa meta kukate. 'Ikɨ naime tepɨte'atɨwa temɨxɨnarienikɨ mawariyari Yawé hɨxie».
Muitsexi meta mawari wewiwame 'Eriyatsaxi mekatenanupini tiwaɨkawame hurukɨ mɨtiwewiyatɨka.
Huru yunaitɨ memiyetɨa xeimiriyari memɨwaruwitɨkɨ meta xeitsienituyari mawari Yawé hetsiemieme mayanikɨ kanayani xeitsienituyari heimana nauka tewiyari heimana tamamata kiruyari.
Yuxaxaɨtatatɨ kuyaxi yu'iwarika mekani'atɨaxɨakaitɨni.
Muitsexi meta mawari wewiwame 'Eriyatsaxi naime mɨkɨ huru mekatenanupini kuyaxi tewa'aitɨwamete memɨtewayetuiri, hikɨ mekaneitɨni 'ixuriki tukiyarita muwa Yawé 'ixaheritsixi yamɨtiwara'eriwanikɨ.
